name: VEIN-NEED-press-keeps-nothing
old: if (!plan || !plan.ready) { passedOn = needLine(plan, rank); return false; }
note: The report as it was: a press a node passed on keeps nothing, so nothing is said when the press opened nothing.

name: VEIN-NEED-press-takes-it-again
old: if (!plan || !plan.ready) { passedOn = needLine(plan, rank); return false; }
new: if (!plan || !plan.ready) { passedOn = needLine(plan, rank); hud.toast(passedOn); return true; }
note: PROF1's old press: the node takes E and says its need - the door, the chest and the foe behind it lose the press (AUDIT 29 C1).

name: VEIN-NEED-a-new-press-remembers-the-old
note: A press with no node under the look hands back the need of a node an earlier press passed on.

name: VEIN-NEED-said-twice
note: One press, a line every time the host asks. CAST-E (re-aimed by content): the line's reset beside the cast's.

name: VEIN-NEED-the-rank-unsaid
note: The need said without the player's own rank - the prompt's words again.

name: VEIN-NEED-the-rank-said-on-every-need
note: A missing Pick-Axe answered with the rank.

name: VEIN-NEED-counted-unsaid
old: if (plan.rest === 'being counted') return 'That gathering is being counted.';
note: A node being counted says the prompt's bare words.

name: VEIN-NEED-mine-marks-no-rank
note: The vein's plan does not say its rank is short: the report's line loses the player's own rank.

name: VEIN-NEED-herb-marks-no-rank
note: A patch's plan does not say its rank is short.

name: VEIN-NEED-tree-marks-no-rank
note: A tree's plan does not say its rank is short.

name: VEIN-NEED-dungeon-foot-silent
old:
if (key === null) { if (interact && !pressCast) host.profNeed?.(); return false; }
    // AUDIT 65 MC-2: the refusal each handler speaks for itself in C# -
new:
if (key === null) { return false; }
    // AUDIT 65 MC-2: the refusal each handler speaks for itself in C# -
note: The report's dungeon: nothing under the ray, and the vein never asked.

name: VEIN-NEED-dungeon-foot-on-a-click
old:
if (key === null) { if (interact && !pressCast) host.profNeed?.(); return false; }
    // AUDIT 65 MC-2: the refusal each handler speaks for itself in C# -
new:
if (key === null) { host.profNeed?.(); return false; }
    // AUDIT 65 MC-2: the refusal each handler speaks for itself in C# -
note: A click, or a touch spell's release, hands back a press no node was asked.

name: VEIN-NEED-dungeon-foot-answers-taken
old:
if (key === null) { if (interact && !pressCast) host.profNeed?.(); return false; }
    // AUDIT 65 MC-2: the refusal each handler speaks for itself in C# -
new:
if (key === null) { if (interact && !pressCast) return host.profNeed?.(); return false; }
    // AUDIT 65 MC-2: the refusal each handler speaks for itself in C# -
note: The ladder answers that its press was taken when only the node spoke.

name: VEIN-NEED-world-no-door
note: The mode machine is handed no door to the node's word underground.

name: VEIN-NEED-street-foot-silent
note: The street's surface veins, trees and patches stay silent when nothing opened.

name: VEIN-NEED-street-foot-on-a-click
note: A click that opened nothing hands back an E press's stale need.

name: VEIN-NEED-street-foot-over-a-door
note: A door that opened, and the node speaks over it.
